tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. Cards and tables sit on `surface`, never directly on `bg` without a border.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Nav bar, cards, fieldsets, table bodies. Text on it: `text`, `text-muted`, `accent`, `ok`, `warn`, `danger`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Table header rows, row hover, secondary buttons, neutral pills, meter tracks. Text on it: `text`, `text-muted`, `accent`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Fill of text inputs and selects. Text on it: `text`; placeholders `text-muted`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges, table row dividers, nav underline. Never the only cue that a control exists; use `border-strong` for that.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of interactive controls (inputs, selects, secondary buttons, flag chips). At least 3:1 on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `accent-soft` and the soft status fills.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, help text, table headers, ids, timestamps, placeholders. Holds 4.5:1 on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one interactive hue: links, active nav item and tab text, primary button fill, meter fill. Text on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `accent-soft` at 4.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button and hover color of links. Carries `on-accent` text at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the active nav item, selected table rows and info pills. Text on it: `accent` or `text`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on `accent` and `accent-hover` fills (primary button). Dark in the dark theme, white in the light theme.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline on every focusable element, 2px offset. At least 3:1 on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Running and healthy state: pill text and dot, meter fill under the warning threshold. Always paired with a word. Text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `ok-soft` at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the ok pill and of a success callout.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings: WARNING log pill, destructive-import callout border, meter fill near the limit. Text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `warn-soft` at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the warning pill and warning callout.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failure and destructive text: failing/crashed pills, quiet delete buttons, error text. Text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `danger-soft` at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the danger pill, danger callout and the hover state of quiet delete buttons.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the solid destructive button, used only on the confirmation step of a delete. Carries `on-danger` text.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on `danger-fill`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind a confirmation dialog. Text never sits directly on it; the dialog's own `surface` carries the text.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", "SF Mono", Consolas, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page: the h1 in the page header.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page (Objects, Read mappings, Device bindings).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text, table cells, form values, buttons use weight 500.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names in cards and rows; emphasis inside body copy.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, always above the field, in `text-muted`.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Help text, page subtitles under the title, pill text.

styles.name: table-head
styles.usage: Table column headers and fieldset legends, set uppercase in `text-muted`.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Object ids (analog-input:1), device numbers, addresses, pids, timestamps, log messages, URLs.

spacing.note: 4px base with a 2px half step. Dense by default: control gaps use space-3 and space-4, card padding space-5, page padding space-6.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between nav links and tabs; icon-to-text nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its field; inside pills and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; horizontal padding of controls and pills.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and fieldset padding; gap between cards; gap between sections inside a card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Checkbox column width; space above a page's first section on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large separations: empty states, space below the last section.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Flag chips and other tiny marks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, callouts, nav links.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, fieldsets, table frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and meter bars.

shadow.note: Borders carry structure; shadows only lift things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus and confirmation dialogs. Nothing else casts a shadow.

size.note: Fixed dimensions that keep the interface dense and aligned.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs, selects and nav links.

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons in table rows and cards.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a table body row.

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: Height of the top navigation bar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a page's content; tables and logs use all of it.

tokens.name: form-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a form column, so fields never stretch across a wide screen.
